Resolves #18908

The parent walks of `Neo.mixin.VdomLifecycle`, `isParentUpdating()` and `mergeIntoParentUpdate()`, now end at an ancestor whose `parentId` is `undefined`. Before, they handed that `undefined` to their own default parameter and restarted from the component itself. Both recursions now pass `parent.parentId ?? null`.

Evidence: **L1** — the unit tier, red without the fix. Residual: none.

agent-preflight: not hosted here; baseline jobs ran. Change class: `defect` (`fix`).

# PR Micro-Review

**Class:** contained. Both recursive calls pass `?? null` so the default parameter can't restart the walk. No new abstraction or contract.

**Verdict:** Approved

**Glance:** This is the neighbour I flagged in my #18901 review, and the claim holds at `f5536f349a`.
- `isParentUpdating(parentId=this.parentId, …)` and `mergeIntoParentUpdate(parentId=this.parentId, …)` recursed with `parent.parentId`. An `undefined` there re-took the default and restarted from the component itself.
- With `null`, `Neo.getComponent(null)` misses and the walk returns `false`.
- `ParentWalkTermination.spec.mjs` passes at this head. With `dev`'s `VdomLifecycle.mjs` it throws `RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded`.
- I looked for a third walk of the same shape: `this.parentId`/`this.id` defaults in `src/` feed only these two recursions, and the rest (`focus`, `getDomRect`, `syncModalMask` …) never pass a parent back in.
- My open #18926 edits other regions of the same file, so neither PR conflicts with the other.

**Findings:** None.
